The red thread on the sword hilt coils sixty-eight times. 
Each loop bears the blood of the Colossus. 
Long before it ever earned the title of Colossus, it already knew, it was born for his death. 
And yet, someone chose to spare its life, burying the sword that should have been drawn, deep underground. The Fish Slaying Sword once wielded by generations of River Masters, was no longer a sword to slay them, but one to guard them. 
The Colossus also knew that the final time it would lay eyes on that sword, it would be the moment to reunite with its master again. 
It waited, and waited, for this day to come.

The majestic Celestial Workshop stands as the Anthem of Ages for the Mohist Gate.
When craftsmen hit creative blocks, they often wander its halls, seeking inspiration from the masterpieces of their predecessors.
Its collections are vast—even the most erudite scholars dare not claim full knowledge. Each generation births new geniuses, whose creations either push the boundaries of ingenuity or simplify complexity, rivaling nature's craftsmanship for the people's benefit.
From the heights of the heavens to the minutiae of daily life, the essence of the Mohist Gate resides within this very workshop.
